batting.dismissal: c T Natarajan b M Jansen

batting.name: Anmolpreet Singh
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b YS Chahal

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b R Ashwin

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b YS Chahal

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b YS Chahal

batting.name: GD Phillips
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b K Yadav

balls.text: this is cruel. The man nails his yorker, but the batter opens the face on it, and somehow places it fine of short third for four more

okay that ramp earlier in the over has put Natarajan off to Plan B. He goes for the slower ball again, and this time Samson is waiting for it. Clears the front leg and lofts this length ball back over his head for a high but small six
misses the yorker but the low full toss is good enough to deny them a boundary. Just the single to long-on

Samson is still looking for the ramp, Natarajan goes slower ball outside off, and Samson is beaten on the reverse-ramp. However, they steal a bye as this reaches Klaasen on the half-volley and he doesn't collect it cleanly
I was wondering why they didn't try the ramp in the 18th over. Anyway, Samson does it now, and lofts this attempted yorker over short fine for four

down the wicket, takes this yorker on the full, lofts it wide of long-on, but this has gone to the left of Jansen, his natural hand, and he sticks out his long arm to keep it in and keep them down to one
low full toss this time, but Hetmyer finds deep midwicket. So two straight overs at the death without a boundary
spot-on yorker now, but Hetmyer has dug this out into the gap between deep square and deep midwicket
yorker, perhaps a couple of inches short of being one, Hetmyer does well to hit it wide of long-on for two

but he has bluffed Buttler this time. Buttler is looking to shuffle to access that wide line, and he spears in a straight yorker/low full toss. Beats him comprehensively, hits him him plumb in front, not given out, and Bhuvneshwar immediately wants a review. The replay confirms it is hitting. Buttler misses out on a century, but walks back with his bat raised to acknowledge the hearty applause he is getting
looks to shuffle and slog, but Bhuvneshwar nails the yorker. Heaved to deep midwicket for one
Bhuvi stays full and wide, Buttler is looking to shuffle and put it into the leg side. Too wide for him. Swept to long-on for one
again nails the yorker. Samson does well to dig it out and place it square of deep cover for two. Fifty for Samson. No boundary in that 18th over, what an effort from Natarajan
nails the yorker, Buttler clears the front leg to dig it out for a single to long-off
short of a length, wide, and cut away straight to point
low full toss, on off, can't do much with it. Just the single to long-off
gets the yorker right, just outside off, and beats his attempt to steer it behind square
quick full toss, Buttler is a little surprise and manages just the single to deep midwicket
wide length ball, slower ball again, driven straight to deep cover for a change
this is definitely a wide as Bhuvneshwar overcooks a wide yorker
backs away early, the wily Bhuvneshwar goes wide, but it is called wide. They don't challenge it either
knuckle ball, on a length, outside off, and Buttler has now beaten that deep cover to his right. he is doing right, left, right to that fielder
walks at him, Bhuvneshwar drags the length back, turned to leg for a single
quick low full toss, driven down to long-off for one
another knuckle ball, wide length ball, and this time he has driven square of that deep cover whom he beat to his right one ball ago
starts with a full toss. Looks like a knuckle ball gone wrong. Driven through extra cover for four
leaves the crease early, Makrande pushes this wide, Samson manages to get an inside edge to save himself from a stumping

there is nothing wrong with this delivery really. He hasn't given it air, and has also managed to bowl the in-between length. Sasmson, though, makes room as he charges at it, and lofts him back over his head
quick, flat, but keeps it on a good length. Pushed down to long-on for one
oh, anticipates correctly the shorter delivery, goes deep in his crease, looks for the straight pull for six, but is beaten by this legbreak
overpitches again, and Buttler clears the front leg to loft him back over his head. Clears the front leg, and comes down hard on it
a slider, flat trajectory, on the stumps, punched down the ground for one
full, on-pace, 141ks, pushed wide of long-on, but Buttler doesn't think there is enough time to come back for the second
stays off pace, short, at 129ks, sticky bounce, and the pull yields just the single to deep square leg
sower ball, on a length, driven to deep cover for another single
slower ball, 128ks, full, just outside off, opens the face for a single
slower ball, drags the length back a touch, and Buttler goes deep in his crease to late-cut it between point and short third
overpitches it a touch, and Buttler crashes this drive past extra cover for a scorching four
Samson finally gets the boundary for this over. Skips down the wicket, gets closer to the ball, which turns out to be a wrong'un, so he goes with the turn and just about clears deep midwicket
Samson is backing away, but Markande follows him and cramps him up
cut away, but can't beat deep cover
senses the big shot is around and bowls a flighted wrong'un, draws the thick inside edge, but it goes along the ground to square leg
again on a length and legbreak, Buttler wants one to long-on but ends up playing it back to Markande
full legbreak, Buttler looks to play off the back foot and is beaten
wrong'un, short, cut away, but can't get it past backward point
cut away to deep cover for one
enough letting him get away with the short lengths. This time Buttler rocks back, and pulls him well over long-on for a six
another dot as he drives this full ball straight to backward point
wrong'un, short of a length, punched straight to extra cover
flatter, quicker, cut away for a couple to deep point
full legbreak but too wide
slower ball into the surface, sticky bounce, Buttler adjusts and pulls it down for a single to deep square leg
short of a length, tucked away off the hip for one
on-pace, into the body, 138ks, Buttler pushes it into the leg side for the single that brings up his fifty
slower ball again, 126ks, Buttler bunts this into the gap between long-on and deep midwicket, and comes back for two
looks to tuck him up with a slower ball, but he strays down leg, and fine leg is in the circle. Buttler helps this past that man
slower ball, on a length, middle and off, pushed into the covers for one
overcooks it when he looks to flight the ball, and Buttler nonchalantly drives the full toss straight of extra cover for four
wrong'un, short of a length, punched to long-off
long hop, and he gets away with it. Much like modern legspinners, he is not trying to turn the ball sideways. The skiddy bounce beats Samson's pull
wrong'un, short, wide, punched to long-off for one
short of a length, quick 93ks, no turn, punched to deep cover
on a length, middle and leg, pushed into the leg side for one
looks for the sweep, is beaten and gets a leg-bye
low full toss, and he has driven it hard and straight of the dicing long-off. RR are racing away here
this is short, and by now they have adjusted to the slow pace of Abhishek, and Buttler plays the straight pull for a flat six into the sight screen
down the wicket for the extra-cover drive, but finds the man
nudged into the leg side for a single
big wide outside leg. Or no, Samson seems to have got a touch on it as he tries to cash in. But not a good enough contact to get runs
and now Buttler tucks in. Rocks back the moment he sees flatter trajectory, and manufactures a pull shot flat over deep midwicket for the third six in the over
on a length, uppishly pushed towards wide long-off for one
slow in the air, 83ks, on a length, on the pads, worked into the leg side for a single
fires this in at 89ks, Samson punches it down to long-on
Samson is taking down their best spinner. Markande pitches it up again, but this time a little wider. So Samson goes over extra cover. Same clean connection. Same result
incredible shot. The moment Markande overpitches, he stays just leg side of the ball, and lofts him for a flat six over long-off. Lovely clean strike
drops this short but he is not giving them any pace to work with. Samson heaves it away but gets just the single to deep square leg
slow in the air, wicket to wicket, punched tyo long-off for another single
driven to long-off for one
full and wide but slow in the air, which is why Samson's attempted cover-drive ends up going back to Abhishek. No replays called for this time
slow in the air, full on the pads, clipped away to deep midwicket

really full, nearly a yorker, or a low full toss even, hit back to Abhishek. Blimey they are checking this with the third umpire when it is clearly a bump ball. What a waste of time. Replay suggests this might have been an arm ball
flatter, quicker, and Samson rocks back to cut it hard and in front of backward point for four
attempts the reverse-sweep, Markande goes full and wide, and he manages just a soft connection for a single fine of short third
short of a length, no pace to work with, punched to deep midwicket for one
flat, wicket to wicket, on a length, pushed to long-off for one
wrong'un, Buttler goes back to deflect it into the leg side. Soft hands make it possible to come back for the second
first ball of spin stays low. Buttler good enough to go back and keep it out
looks for the big cover-drive, is cramped up a little, and ends up with a single to deep cover
cleverly played. Natarajan goes for the slower ball, 126ks, Samson delays the shot, and steers this length ball fine of short third. Plays it really late
on a length, angling in towards top of off, pushed to cover-point
beaten outside off. Drive away from the body, and it holds its line
Samson drives on the up, middles it, but can't beat cover-point
full, outside off, pushed to mid-off for a quick single

Jansen's extra bounce does the job for him. Again slower offcutter, into the pitch, 128ks, Jaiswal is looking to help it over short third, but the ball makes contact closer to his glove than the middle of the bat. Easy catch for Natarajan at short third
slower ball again, short of a length, 129ks, the extra bounce beats Jaiswal's attempt to steer it fine
slower ball, Jaiswal defends it back to him
half-volley, and even though they have a sweeper on the off side, Jaiswal has square-driven it so hard the fielder has no chance
bowling short with both fine leg and third in the circle. Jaiswal tries the hook, can't control it, and the top edge flies over short third for four. Yorks the boundary triangles
looks to work this to leg, but gets a soft leading edge to mid-off and sneaks in a single
yorker, Jaiswal again looks to steer it behind square, but ends up playing it straight to short third
looks to run this down behind square but can't beat short third
on a length, middle and leg, pushed to mid-off
same ball, same shot, and a different result. Jaiswal delays his down swing to adjust to the knuckle ball, and lofts it over long-on for a six. This man is in some form
inside edge as Bhuvneshwar slips in a knuckle ball. He is looking to whack it down the ground, but the inside edge will do just fine
on a length, outside off, pushed past cover, but they now have a sweeper on the off side
nudges this length ball into the leg side for a single
Buttler gets going. A drive away from the body, but he is not looking to keep it down, and goes over short cover
thick edge as he drives away from the body and on the up. Gets a single to square third
full and straight, pushed to mid-on for a quick single
big wide down the leg side, and it takes a full-length dive from Klaasen
tight line, headed for top of off, 137ks, punched to mid-off
full outside off, pushed to short cover
he is a wee man but he packs a punch. Jansen goes short again, doesn't get it too high, and Jaiswal pulls it over forward square leg for a massive six
extra bounce, and it flies over Jaiswal's attempted upper-cut. too high. Called a wide
moves towards off with this length ball, and Buttler drops this wide of midwicket for one
this time Buttler has got bat on it. An ordinary delivery. pitched well outside leg, and Buttler glances it away fine of fine leg
all the luck running RR's way in the early playts. Jansen gets good bounce from just short of a length, and the ball flies off the thigh pad for four leg-byes
pitches it right up, outside off, Buttler looks for the drive, but is beaten by the angle. Playing for the swing there
thick edge as he looks to punch this through covers. Gets a single to third
shimmies at him, covers the line, and then leaves it alone outside off
pushed wide of mid-on for one

Vivrant Sharma has not picked this at all. Jaiswal has flicked this loose ball straight to fine leg. Vivrant needs to move in two paces, I think, to make it, but he has not picked the ball at all, and it bounces and skids through his legs for four
swinging in, pushed towards mid-on
this one seams away from him. Pitched on a length, around off, and beats his outside edge
uppish flick first ball. It seems to have stopped in the surface as he looks to push at this length ball, and it balloons up. Just enough in it to clear mid-on

and SRH have pulled off a heist here. Hearts broken inside the RR camp. One run-out, two simple catches, and SRH have capitalised. Sandeep goes wide again, goes for the yorker, misses it by a few inches, and Samad slams it back over his head for a flat six after having shuffled across

Sandeep finishes it off again. Oh no. Stop the celebrations. Sandeep is raising a finger to the sky, but it turns out he has overstepped. The dreaded siren goes off. He has gone really full, nearly a yorker, and Samad drills it straight down to long-off
Jansen shuffles across, Sandeep missies the yorker, but the lower full toss is hit straight to deep midwicket for one
a low full toss, a really low full toss, dug out to long-off for one
yorker spot on, dug out, not enough power in it, and that allows them a second

and Samad proceeds to rub it in. Sandeep nearly nails the yorker outside off, Samad drills it straight down the ground. It is sailing over Root, who leaps and gets a left hand on it, but can't keep it in
goes for the wide yorker, gets a thick edge, McCoy runs back from short third man, gets under it, but fails to get even a hand to it. Another drop from RR
misses the yorker again, Jansen chips this low full toss over extra cover and comes back for two

Hetmyer takes a stunner. Kuldip breathes a sigh of relief. He goes length, on-pace, Phillips sees a six in it, but toe-ends it for skier. Now is the confusion. Jaiswal is running in, Hetmyer is going back, and it is Hetmyer who has called for it. over his shoulder, outstretched arms, and he takes it
and now the luck goes with Phillips. Wide length ball, he throws his hands at it, and the outside edge goes wide of short third
Six. Six. Six. Kuldip goes into the pitch, slower ball, 109ks, and Phillips has pulled this clean over midwicket for the third six of the over
whoa whoa whoa. The game is on. An even higher full toss. Two yorkers missed in two balls, and Phillips lofts it over wide long-off for another six
misses the yorker, and Phillips launches the low full toss over long-off for six. Is there still life in this match?
4-0-29-4 for Chahal as he gets a bottom edge from Samad on the last ball of his quota

beaten on the reverse-sweep, and Im sure he will review the lbw call. he has reviewed it. To me, the only question is, did it straighten enough? Chahal fires in this legbreak, it pitches with in the stumps, beats his bat and glove, hits him in front of leg, and is hitting leg. Just straightens enough to be pitching within the stumps and be hitting the stumps
and Chahal goes slow and wide. Punched down to deep cover for one
a quick slider, he chops down on it, and comes back for two as he has managed to place it wide of deep cover

Chahal the man. It is such a precarious job, bowling spin. Mis-hits fly for sixes these days. He is still brave enough to slow it down again, gets some turn, gets a top edge on the slog-sweep, and Jaiswal takes a superb catch on the boundary line. Imagine he has done Tripathi in completely, but another metre, and it would still have been a six
big ripping legbreak as he slows it down. Beats him comprehensively as he tries to sweep
that is unfortunate. Markram is actually looking to pull out if this sharp short ball when the ball hits the bat and flies over short fine for four
tries the reverse ramp, is beaten by a slower ball, and Samson fumbles again. No damage done this time
slower ball, wide full toss, just the single to deep cover
and he rubs it in with a pulled six. Sounds very sweet off the bat but it has only just cleared the boundary. Quite lucky it has not gone straight to deep midwicket but to the right of him

Samson is having a horror day with the gloves. After missing a straightforward run-out earlier, he has dropped this simple catch. On pace, back of a length, outside leg, Tripathi is late into it, and gloves it through. Samson's gloves are not in the right place, he tries to juggle it, but can't hold on
slower ball, big wide down the leg side
short of a length, cramps him up even as he backs away. Just the single into the covers
full, just outside off, driven to deep cover for one

good as gold, Chahal's slow wide tantalising legbreak works. He pitched short last ball, but this time he has flighted it, pitched on a length, just 75ks, got the turn, and Klaasen ends up mis-hitting it to long-off
this time he goes slow and wide, but Klaasen doesn't premeditate as much as the batters Chahal has fooled in the past. He goes back and cuts it past point fort four
no he goes quick and wide, 98ks, hit back to Chahal
but that won't matter if Klaasen keeps doing this for some time. Slight shuffle, down on a knee, and slog-sweeps this full ball for a 96m six
fired into the pads, a single to short fine leg
slower ball, short of a length, 115ks, Klaasen punches it down powerfully, and places it straight of the diving long-off
slower ball to Tripathi again, just short of being a yorker, driven to long-on for one
nails the yorker, dug out for a single to long-on
shuffles early looking for the ramp, Kuldip bowls the slower one outside off, and concedes just the single
yorker, perhaps just a touch fuller than a yorker, but Klaasen can't get under it. Just the single to long-off
bouncer, pulled down in front of deep midwicket, and comes back for two
shapes up for a reverse early, and M Ashwin bowls it slow, full and wide to get out of the over with a dot
wide length ball, hit hard, square of deep cover, comes back for two more
wide legbreak, again overpitched, and Tripathi coolly opens the face to drive it over backward point
second full toss of the over, and Tripathi is down on a knee to slog him over midwicket for the second six of the over
wrong'un, short of a length, punched to long-on, Tripathi turns for two, then sends Klaasen back, and he is saved by an inaccurate throw
full toss on the pads from M Ashwin, and Klaasen accepts it with thanks. Slogs it over midwicket
slows it down, 88ks, but still a carrom ball. Pushed down to long-off
carrom ball, 98ks, pushed to extra cover

the problem for SRH is, one six an over is not good enough. Abhishek has to keep taking risks, and Ashwin stays away from his arc. Gets just that bit of turn to take the edge to short third as Abhishek tries to go over long-off
tries the slog sweep, his foot slips just as he is about to connect, one hand comes off, and still he gets enough of it for a six over midwicket
reverse-sweep, Ashwin nearly beats him with a straight ball, but Tripathi has got some bat on it for a single to short third
on a length, on off, driven down to long-on for a single
tries to hide this wide outside off, but overcooks it
wrong'un, wicket to wicket, driven to long-off
the asking rate is climbing, and they have to play the shots. Abhishek goes deep in his crease to a flatter length and pulls him over wide long-on for six
skiddy legbreak, no room, bottom edge back to him
trying to loft down the ground but M Ashwin is not giving him the length. Another single to long-on
pulled away into the leg side for one

wrong'un, reads it off the pitch, hits it straight to point, is sent back, is gone for all money, and seems like Samson has broken the wicket while going for the ball. Only one bail falls so he has a second chance and Abhishek is still short. But Samson fails to collect the ball at all. The throw was accurate. An eminently forgettable ball for Samson the keeper
wide on the crease, carrom ball, 93ks, pitches it on a length and within the stumps. Pushed back to Ashwin
quick and wide, cut away to extra cover for one
into the pads, on a length, chipped to long-on for one
carrom ball, 98ks, Tripathi gets the width, and he has cut this past the diving backward point for four
on a length, offbreak, middle and leg, pushed to long-on for one
quick wide offbreak, but too wide
fired into the pads at 94ks, lapped into the leg side, past short fine. M Ashwin fields from deep square, tries to relay it to Chahal but ends up lobbing him, and allows then a third
tries another six over long-on but is nowhere near the pitch of this ball. The mis-hit falls well short of long-on
pitches it up this time without letting him drive. Pushed to long-on for one
fired in outside leg at 94ks, Abhishek laps it square of short fine leg for four
fired in on a length, 95ks, Tripathi gets a single to deep midwicket
Tripathi gets a move on. Slightly pitched up, and he lofts him over long-on for an 84m six
on a length, outside leg, worked to deep midwicket for one
full and quick, just outside off, driven to long-off for one
cut away in front of point this time, and they get two by the time the deep cover comes around
slower ball, short and wide, 112ks, and he gets away with it as it is cut straight to point
on a length, angling in, pushed between deep midwicket and long-on and they steal the second
on a length, just outside off, pushed to the right of cover, who hits the stumps direct and concedes an overthrow too
short of a length, Tripathi opens the face, can't get it past short third
quicker, tighter line, and it turns in further to allows him runs in the leg side. Abhishek sweeps it square of short fine for four
slows it down big time as he sees Abhishek shimmy down. It is bowled at 72ks. Played straight to cover
tosses this up, slower in the air, 84ks, drilled to long-on for a single
slider, on off, 86ks, Tripathi late-cuts it straight to point
pitched up on off, worked into the leg side for one more
shapes up for the reverse early, Chahal slows it down big time, at 76ks the ball never arrives and he is lucky to get a bit of bat in this as it is quite straight
wide on the crease to bowl another carrom ball, swept along the ground to deep midwicket for one
fires it in again at 98ks, punched down to long-on
slows it down, 87ks, a lovely dipping offbreak, beats his outside edge, and we are checking the stumping with the third umpire. The back foot never slides or leaves ground.
wide on the crease again, carrom ball again, gets the leading edge, but it falls wide of Ashwin
wide on the crease, bowls the carrom ball, beats him, but it is called wide
97ks again, on a length, just outside off, a single in front of point
fires in an offbreak at 97ks, pushed down to long-on
on a length, middle and off, pushed wide of cover for one
Chahal was sensing something. He goes full and middle and leg again. Just gets a bit of dip on this one, and Anmol gets a top edge on the slog sweep. Caught by Hetmyer running in from deep midwicket
short of a length, punched down to wide of long-off
just ends up overpitching this time.Perhaps looking to turn it from full and straight. Anmol clears the front leg and lofts him over mid-on
quicker, slightly shorter length, 91ks, and still he beats him with the legbreak
rips a legbreak past his outside edge. On a length, 84ks, and then big turn
lovely shot. Makes room, gets under a full ball, and drives it over extra cover for four
short ball again, and again a top edge. Falls well short of dee square leg
yorker this time, on leg, dug out for a single to long-on
slides down the leg side from around the wicket, and it is easy pickings with the fine leg up
surprises him with the bouncer, draws the top edge, but it falls short of the mid-on running in

Anmol backs away early, Sandeep goes with him, and then he stays inside the line to play the pick up into the leg side. M Ashwin runs to his right from deep forward square leg, puts in a valiant effort, but can't save the boundary
slows it down, 89ks, too full to get under, takes the to end of his attempted sweep and bounces short of deep midwicket
wider on the crease, goes flat, carrom ball I think, 96ks, and this time Anmol cuts him in front of square for four
on a length, on off, driven down to long-off
overpitched, hit hard but can't beat mid-off. A single off the fumble
again 96ks, slides this wide outside off and beats his attempt to cut him
starts off quick, 97ks, full, driven to long-off for one
again Sandeep follows a batter backing away, but this time Anmol holds himself and then uses the angle to pick it up over square leg for four
sees him back away and follows him with a slower ball. Just the single to long-on
lovely shot. Flat-bats a wide length ball back over Sandeep's head for four
follows Anmol as he backs away. Just the single to wide of mid-off
slower ball, Anmol has to adjust the shot, and ends up playing it to the straight midwicket
on a length, wicket to wicket, pushed back to him
on a length, angling in, nicely timed but straight to midwicket
on a length, angling across, mis-hit towards extra cover, which allows them to come through for one
just enough. Gets the front foot across to play the pick-up shot, Hetmyer runs to his left from deep square leg, leaps in the air, but the best he can manage is just a touch on it
wide length ball, Anmol goes across the line and hits it powerfully but straight to mid-on
on a length, angling across, driven on the up, straight to extra cover
on a length, angling in, a leg-bye off the thigh pad
low full toss, he has a deep forward square leg to keep them down to two
swings this in down the line. Abhishek pushes it to mid-off for a quick single
and he goes really full with the cushion of long-on. Driven to the man in deep for one
pitches this up pushed straight to mid-on
opens the face on a length ball, but can't beat backward point
on a length, slightly outside off, driven straight to extra cover
